attr.title: Gone Fishing
attr.desc: A quiet pixel-art fishing game. Row or motor across five places, from an autumn lake to the Columbia River under Mt. Hood, and cast with real physics to put your lure where the fish swim. 42 fish with their own fights, five legends, ten lures, bobbers, trolling, day and night, weather, goals, gear upgrades, three save slots, a customizable angler and a dog or cat for company.
